about.author: @Kaiconure
about.description: Ensures that your battle target always lines up with the party leader.

comment: While in the leader strategy, disengages from your current battle target when:
1. The party leader has no battle target -OR-
2. The party leader has a battle target that differs from yours.
In these cases, disengaging will cause the leader strategy to automatically
re-engage you with the proper target to stay in sync with the leader.
when: (not party_leader_bt and vars.leader_sync.idle_disengage) or (party_leader_bt and party_leader_bt.id ~= bt.id)
commands: not party_leader_bt and (disengage() and logf('Disengaging from [%s] as party leader has no target!', bt.name))
party_leader_bt and setBattleTarget(party_leader_bt) and logf('Acquiring leader target %s!', party_leader_bt.name) and wait(1)
